title: Scarf Workshop for Betty
shortDescription: A guided 10-day workshop to knit your first scarf
description: This guided workshop takes you through the complete process of knitting a beautiful scarf, from choosing yarn to blocking the finished piece.

days.title: Define the scarf

blocks.content: Welcome to Day 1! Today you're deciding what this scarf will be. Keep it simple — clarity now makes everything else easier.

blocks.title: Pro tip
blocks.content: Don't overthink it. A simple garter stitch scarf can be beautiful and relaxing to knit.

items.text: Decide on scarf width and length
Post your decisions in the hub comments

days.shortDescription: Choose stitch, width, and finish line.

days.title: Swatch + set tension
days.shortDescription: Create a small swatch and confirm your numbers.

days.title: Cast on + start knitting
days.shortDescription: Get a clean start and knit the first section.

days.title: Midpoint reset
days.shortDescription: Measure, adjust, and keep going with confidence.

days.title: Finish planning
days.shortDescription: Choose your ending and finishing method.

days.title: Knit to length
days.shortDescription: Reach your finish line with clean edges.

days.title: Bind off
days.shortDescription: Use a bind-off that matches the scarf's stretch and look.

days.title: Finishing
days.shortDescription: Weave ends, tidy edges, optional fringe.

days.title: Block + photo
days.shortDescription: Final polish and a simple 'done' share.

days.title: Bonus: Variations + what to knit next

blocks.content:
You're done! 🎉

This bonus section is completely optional. Use it if you're curious about variations or already thinking about your next project.

blocks.content: If you're done and happy, that's success. This bonus is here only if you want it.
